title: Replacement of Trestle tower at Kadamath Lighthouse in the UT of Lakshadweep - Fabrication & Supply of 30m high GI Trestle tower (Hot dipped Galvanized) at Deep Bhavan, Kochi
summary: E-tender to fabricate and supply a 30 m high hot-dip galvanized GI trestle tower at Deep Bhavan, Kochi, for replacement of the trestle tower at Kadamath Lighthouse, Lakshadweep.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Kadamath Lighthouse, UT of Lakshadweep
sites.work: Replacement of trestle tower (new 30m GI trestle tower)

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, Kochi
sites.work: Location for fabrication and supply of the tower

scope.item: Fabrication & Supply of 30m high GI Trestle tower (Hot dipped Galvanized)

money.notes: Tender fee Nil. EMD shown as Rs 32,302 in the NIT table but Rs 33,918 in Terms & Conditions clause 01; by DD/FDR in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin payable at Ernakulam. Originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) to be submitted physically; last date of EMD 26.08.2026 1500 hrs.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies; OR for Lakshadweep contractors, work experience with any Government department in island works during last 7 years
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80%

Similar works: erection of trestle/lighthouse/communication tower or construction/maintenance of residential/institutional/office building, road etc. (Hindi text instead mentions painting of tall buildings, LH towers, trestle towers)
Annual turnover of last three years certified by Chartered Accountant
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper that bidder is not blacklisted
Undertaking listing relatives serving as Gazetted/Account officers in MoPSW or DGLL
Copy of EPF / labour registration certificate; Tender Acceptance Letter; Bid Securing Declaration
specs: 30 m high GI trestle tower, hot dipped galvanized
notes: Document is Section I (NIT) only, printed pages 2-6; no BOQ or technical specification included. EMD mismatch within NIT (Rs 32,302 in table vs Rs 33,918 in clause 01). Listing end date 2026-08-27 matches bid submission end; listing bid_opening 2026-08-27 differs from NIT tech-bid opening 28.08.2026. Bid submission period 07.08.2026 1000 hrs to 27.08.2026 1500 hrs; bid query last date 11.08.2026.
